title: Deep learning scores Claudin18.2 staining in gastric cancer slides across clones
summary: A pipeline that scores Claudin18.2 immunohistochemistry on whole-slide images used a LoRA-adapted UNI pathology foundation model for tumour recognition, adapter-based staining-intensity classification and two rounds of active learning. Agreement with pathologist-consensus 2/3+ scoring was ICC 0.849 on 195 internal test slides and 0.894 on 135 prospectively collected slides, and ICC 0.792-0.827 for three other antibody clones tested without retraining. In a non-randomised reader study, AI assistance improved every pathologist's agreement with the reference standard and shortened review time. The authors state the study is single-centre with limited prospective and cross-clone cohorts, uses expert consensus rather than absolute ground truth, may propagate errors across modules, and provides no treatment-response or outcome data; at the 50% cutoff the retrospective AUC was lower than one pathologist's.
ai_technology: UNI pathology foundation model (ViT-L/16) adapted with LoRA and inserted adapters, plus active learning, for tumour recognition and staining-intensity scoring.
organization: Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center; Sun Yat-sen University School of Computer Science and Engineering; Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center

evidence.tested: Slide-level agreement with pathologist consensus on 195 internal test slides and 135 prospectively collected slides, cross-clone evaluation of three further antibody clones, and a six-pathologist reader study.
evidence.unknown: Single centre; limited prospective and cross-clone cohorts; reader study not randomised; no therapy-response or outcome data; the paper does not state whether the model was frozen before prospective enrolment, so this is treated as evaluation on collected slides rather than prospective workflow use.
evidence.ai_role: Foundation-model-based tumour recognition and staining-intensity modules produce the slide-level Claudin18.2 score.

source_review.scope: PMC full text read: model components, cohorts, ICC results, reader study and author limitations; Europe PMC preprint search found no earlier version.
